title: ipomoea involucrata
intro: Ipomoea involucrata, commonly known as Purple Back Morning Glory or Manjishtha, is a perennial flowering vine in the Convolvulaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea involucrata include its potential to treat skin conditions, such as acne and eczema, as well as its ability to act as an immunomodulator and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of Ipomoea involucrata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
